title: Duplicate Scan Queue Age
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:ops format_type=* dedupe_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(dedupe_state!="resolved",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by format_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending duplicate scans backlog by format type for archive cleanup.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside archive cleanup.
implementation: Mark each `memory:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `format_type`.
visualization: Table of format type with pending duplicate scans counts.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates where unfinished duplicate scans are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in archive cleanup.
